title: 01 雁荡山云海日出
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Aerial documentary shot of Yandang Mountain in Zhejiang, China at sunrise: jagged rhyolite peaks with vertical striations rise above a sea of clouds, layered ridges receding into blue mist, warm golden light raking across the rock faces, wind-shaped pine trees clinging to cliffs, thin fog drifting between the stone spires. The camera performs a slow continuous aerial push-in with large amplitude at slow speed, descending slightly toward the main peak while cloud layers slide past the lens.

At 00:04.000, the camera tilts down gently, revealing the depth of the valley below, the cloud sea churning slowly.
At 00:08.000, the camera keeps moving forward, a soft sun flare appears at the frame edge, mist swirling around the peaks.

overall_soundscape:
High-altitude wind, distant birdsong, soft rustle of pines, airy spacious ambience with faint cloud movement.

non_diegetic_music:
Sparse cinematic strings with sustained low cello and a gentle piano motif, slow tempo, awe-inspiring and serene.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 35mm aerial lens, natural filmic color grade with cool shadows and warm highlights, high dynamic range, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.

title: 02 大龙湫飞瀑
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Ground-level documentary shot of the Dalongqiu waterfall in Yandang Mountain: a single ribbon of water plunging 190 meters down a dark volcanic cliff, fine white mist rising and drifting through backlit sunbeams, wet black rocks covered with green moss and ferns at the base, a small plunge pool with rippling concentric circles. The camera slowly tilts up from the pool to the top of the fall with medium amplitude at slow speed, mist drifting across the frame.

At 00:04.000, the tilt reaches mid-fall, water threads catching the light and breaking into spray.
At 00:08.000, the camera settles near the top edge, the sun behind the water creating a soft bloom.

overall_soundscape:
Roaring falling water, hissing spray, water dripping on stone, natural echo inside the gorge.

non_diegetic_music:
Deep low strings with a soft taiko-like pulse, building slowly, grounded and powerful.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 24mm wide lens, slow shutter giving the falling water a silky texture, backlit high-contrast lighting, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.

title: 03 楠溪江竹筏晨雾
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Documentary shot of the Nanxi River in Wenzhou, Zhejiang: crystal-clear shallow emerald water revealing round stones on the riverbed, a bamboo raft with a standing boatman poling slowly through low morning mist, old white-walled black-tiled village houses and bamboo groves along the bank, a few ducks, mirror-like reflections. The camera tracks laterally at water level with small amplitude at slow speed, the raft drifting through the frame.

At 00:04.000, the raft passes the center of frame, the pole dipping into the water, ripples spreading.
At 00:08.000, mist thickens near the far bank, village rooftops emerging.

overall_soundscape:
Soft water lapping against the raft, the creak of the bamboo pole, distant rooster and village morning sounds, riverside birds.

non_diegetic_music:
Gentle guzheng and bamboo flute, pastoral and unhurried, light reverb.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 35mm lens at water level, soft misty morning light, natural colors, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.

title: 04 泰顺廊桥与乌岩岭
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Documentary shot of a Taishun covered bridge (langqiao) in Wenzhou, hidden in misty ancient forest: a dark timber bridge with a tiled roof spanning a clear stream, massive old trees with hanging moss, ferns and wet rocks, fog drifting between trunks, soft diffused morning light filtering through the canopy. The camera cranes down slowly from the canopy to bridge level with medium amplitude at slow speed.

At 00:04.000, the bridge structure comes into full view, its reflection trembling on the stream.
At 00:08.000, fog rolls across the bridge deck, a shaft of light breaking through the trees.

overall_soundscape:
Forest birdsong, a stream flowing over stones, leaves rustling, faint creak of old timber.

non_diegetic_music:
Warm strings with a hint of Chinese flute, intimate and timeless.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 50mm lens, soft diffused light, mossy green and deep brown palette, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.

title: 05 南麂列岛海岸
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Aerial documentary shot of the Nanji Islands marine reserve in Wenzhou: granite sea cliffs meeting turquoise-blue water, white surf exploding against dark rocks, seabirds wheeling above the water, green grassy slopes on the island ridge, distant islands fading in haze, late afternoon golden light. The camera flies forward low over the water then rises over the cliff edge with medium amplitude at slow speed.

At 00:04.000, the camera clears the cliff top, revealing the open sea stretching to the horizon.
At 00:08.000, a wave breaks below, spray catching the sun, birds crossing the frame.

overall_soundscape:
Waves crashing on rock, gull cries, steady wind over the headland, distant surf.

non_diegetic_music:
Expansive orchestral strings, uplifting with a wide stereo field, moderate tempo.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 24mm aerial lens, natural golden hour light, rich blue and warm stone tones, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.

title: 06 江心屿落日与瓯江夜色
prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Documentary shot of Jiangxin Island in the Oujiang River at sunset: two ancient pagodas silhouetted against a burning orange sky, the river surface golden and rippled, small boats crossing, tree canopies framing the towers. The camera slowly rises and pulls back with small amplitude at slow speed.

At 00:05.000, the sun touches the horizon, the sky deepening from orange to violet.
At 00:07.500, city lights switch on along both river banks in blue hour, their reflections stretching across the water as the pagodas become dark silhouettes.

overall_soundscape:
Lapping river water, a distant ferry horn, the hum of the evening city, birds settling for the night.

non_diegetic_music:
Reflective piano with soft strings, closing theme, gentle resolve at the end.

Photorealistic, shot on a cinema camera with a 70mm lens from across the river, golden hour into blue hour transition, cinematic contrast, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logos.
